title: Vibha Boston Garba 2026 - An Evening of Dance, Culture & Giving
description: Get ready to dance the night away with nonstop Garba beats and good vibes at Vibha Boston 2026!
long_description:
Get ready to dance the night away with nonstop Garba beats and good vibes at Vibha Boston 2026!

About this Event

Join us for an unforgettable evening of Garba, Dandiya, music, and community—where every spin, every beat, and every ticket helps transform a child's future through education.
Your evening of celebration helps transform the lives of children through education—because every ticket sold supports Vibha's mission of creating brighter futures.
Whether you're a seasoned Garba dancer or stepping onto the dance floor for the very first time, come celebrate one of the most vibrant festivals of the year while making a meaningful difference.

✨ What to Expect💃 Four hours of energetic Garba & Dandiya dancing🎧 High-energy music by our DJ featuring traditional Garba favorites and Bollywood hits🪔 A vibrant Navratri celebration with hundreds of community members🍽️ Delicious Indian snacks and dinner available for purchase🛍️ Festival Marketplace featuring local vendors offering traditional clothing, jewelry, accessories, gifts, and more📸 Beautiful décor and festive atmosphere perfect for making memories❤️ An opportunity to celebrate while supporting children's education

Grab your tickets early and save! A limited number of Early Bird tickets are available at a special discounted price.
Once they're gone, Regular Admission pricing begins.
Tickets purchased at the door will be available at the highest price, subject to availability.
Don't wait—secure your tickets early and enjoy the best value!
